a promotion within the same company
there are few levels of management between staff and leadership
decisions take a very long time
become self-employed, start your own business
someone practicing a liberal profession (doctor, journalist, translator, etc.)

practice.prompt: "Durchsetzungsvermögen" in a job ad means the candidate should be able to:

the training-in period for a new job
the length of a work contract

Quereinstieg always requires a university degree

quiz.prompt: "Bevor sie loslegen konnte, musste sie ein Gewerbe anmelden." — where would this typically happen?

they always work for a single employer

choices: few levels of management between staff and leadership
